Definition: to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury
BiblicalUsage: 1) to withhold, hold back, keep back, refrain, deny, keep restrain, hinder; 1a) (Qal) to withhold; 1b) (Niphal) to be withheld
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
